description: This file contains functions for building and preparing media content, including image metadata extraction, media info construction, and media upload with optional encryption, specifically for matrix media messages.

methods.name: buildMatrixMediaInfo
methods.description: Constructs media info object based on size, mimetype, duration, and image info.

methods.name: buildMediaContent
methods.description: Creates a media content object for matrix messages, including handling encryption and relations.

methods.name: prepareImageInfo
methods.description: Generates image metadata and thumbnail, optionally encrypting the thumbnail.

methods.name: resolveMediaDurationMs
methods.description: Extracts media duration in milliseconds from a buffer, supporting audio and video types.

methods.name: uploadMediaMaybeEncrypted
methods.description: Uploads media content with optional encryption based on room encryption status.
